rootRule: Weather Mother opens the protected World runtime by default.
navigationRule: The interface stays closed until the user taps the Liquid Glass WM launcher.
rainRule: One tap on Rain directly opens Liquid Rain V1.3. Extra Rain or Liquid selection layers are prohibited.
portraitRule: On iPhone Max portrait, use a safe-area-aware bottom sheet with compact, medium and full heights.
landscapeRule: On iPhone Max landscape, use a safe-area-aware right panel and preserve the main scene on the left.
controlRule: Current Rain controls are grouped into Rain, Cloud Source, Ground Water, Wet Glass, Roof and Masonry, and View.
worldRule: The accepted v110-full cloud runtime remains immutable unless the user explicitly requests a targeted change.
deliveryRule: Routine delivery contains one verified direct public workbench URL only.
